background: CIC is a French retail and corporate bank, the main non-mutual subsidiary of Credit Mutuel Alliance Federale, with a regional branch network across France and a corporate and investment banking arm.
synthesis: Ratings are AA- from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A+ from S&P and Aa3 from Moody's, but Fitch's outlook is negative where the other two are stable. The ratios are on the weak side of EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 12.6% is in the bottom quarter against a 16.4% median, leverage of 4.7% is below the 5.5% median, LCR of 146% is below the 151% median and NSFR of 108% is in the bottom quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods, with figures to 31 Mar 2026. Nothing flagged in the last 90 days. The comfort here is the mutual group behind it rather than the subsidiary's own ratios.
